Hi Liam — thanks for sending these over and for the fast follow-up.

Quick checklist items from our side:
- I forwarded the bank letter and W-9 to finance (jonas is cc'd) so they can record the proof and open the payee profile.
- Please confirm the two micro-deposit amounts once you see them, then we'll mark ACH verified.
- For PO mapping: we require the vendor to include a PO reference in the remittance that matches our PO number exactly (PO-4829). Your CSV looks good — can you confirm the exact header names you plan to send in payoff files? We ask for: invoice_number, po_number, amount, payment_date.

Jonas — could you please pick this up in the payments portal once Camila confirms the micro-deposit match? If all good, schedule the initial settlement for 2028-04-25 and route remittance to accounting@payflowhq.com as per their sample.

Thanks — Camila
